zoe: Heads-up 1: tiny runtime change tonight 23:15 UTC. Need someone to drop the internal announce + pin.
mike: I got the pin and will post at cutover.
tara: Draft blurb: "Deploy: lower memory footprint + batching tweak. No user-facing API changes. Expect brief p99 bump during KV warmup."
zoe: Add rollback criteria and fallback doc link pls.
mike: Rollback triggers: 5xx >= 3% for 5m OR p99 > 2x baseline for 10m. Fallback = pin to v1.3. Runbook: https://internal.redwood/release/1790001234-runbook
deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled by @mike at 2026-03-22T23:15:00Z. Canary: 10% for 20m -> 50% for 10m -> 100%. Heartbeats every 5m.
tara: Recommend first canary 25m (cache warm). mike ok?
mike: fine, updating cadence. deploy-bot please change.
deploy-bot: Canary updated 1: 10% for 25m -> 50% for 10m -> 100%. Heartbeat cadence unchanged. Canary id: 1790001234-canary.
docs-bot: small docs note: use phrase "No user-facing API changes" to avoid confusion.
mike: noted, will use that wording in the announce.
deploy-bot: heartbeat 3/6 15m into canary: no error spike.
tara: Observability: p99 ~+7% first 10m then back to baseline. batch_hit_rate trending up. No alerts.
deploy-bot: heartbeat 6/6 1: Deploy to 100% complete. No rollbacks triggered.
mike: Posting internal announce and pin now: "Shipped: runtime memory + batching improvements. No user-facing API changes. Ops standby: @tara @mike. Rollback cmd & runbook pinned."
zoe: Thanks everyone. Leaving a 24h follow-up check in calendar. :white_check_mark:
